authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL ślakṣṇa gives Prakrit laṇha/saṇha small, Punjabi nannhā/nannā, Hindi nanhā and Gujarati nāhnũ/nānũ small. Simple survey nahna/nānu/nani short follow this diminutive-size family with ordinary ending variation and a small-to-short sense extension explicitly qualified. Extra -l/-k/-c forms are excluded. Local IA transmission is unresolved. Exact response: nānu.
